[#hash-backends-of-whirlpool]
.Who implements `digests::whirlpool` (ISO/IEC 10118-3 (Whirlpool, Barreto and Rijmen))
[cols="2,1,2,2,3,1",options="header"]

What each backend states on constant time, as the capability table read it:

* `botan`: Botan 3.14.1: doc/api_ref/hash.rst warns that Whirlpool's baseline implementation uses table lookups indexed by the data and is likely vulnerable to cache-based side channels; its constant-time code needs AVX2 or AVX-512, instruction-set modules that /third_party//botan's minimized build does not load.

`digests::whirlpool` has no default backend: the call names one of its backends, as its second template argument (<<hash-default-backend>>).
